lessons.title: Can the Zelda remake capture the magic of the original?
lessons.title_zh: 《薩爾達》重製版能否捕捉原作的魔力？

paragraphs.en: On Thursday, the anticipated remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time officially arrived after years of persistent rumors. When the original game launched in 1998 on the Nintendo 64 (N64), it set the standard for 3D action games. Many features that modern players take for granted, such as riding horses and targeting enemies, were pioneered in this classic title. Decades later, it remains the highest-rated video game in history on the review aggregation website Metacritic.
paragraphs.zh: 週四，在有關重製版的多年間持續傳聞之後，《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》備受期待的重製版正式登場。當原作於 1998 年在任天堂 64（N64）主機上推出時，它為 3D 動作遊戲樹立了標準。許多現代玩家視為理所當然的特色，例如騎馬和鎖定敵人，都是在這款經典作品中開創的。數十年後，它在評論彙整網站 Metacritic 上依然是史上評分最高的電玩遊戲。

paragraphs.en: Instead of completely changing the formula, Nintendo chose to keep the remake very close to the original version. Series producer Eiji Aonuma and producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi explained that modern graphics help express details clearly without requiring players to rely heavily on imagination. However, improved visual power also brought unexpected challenges. Aonuma noted that testers told the team the spooky Skulltula House was "too scary," prompting adjustments to maintain the original balance between frightening and funny moments.
paragraphs.zh: 任天堂沒有徹底改變遊戲模式，而是選擇讓這款重製版與原作版本非常相近。系列製作人青沼英二與製作人藤林秀麿解釋，現代畫面有助於清楚呈現細節，而不需要玩家過度依賴想像力。然而，提升後的視覺運算能力也帶來了意想不到的挑戰。青沼指出，測試人員告訴團隊陰森的骷髏蛛之家「太嚇人了」，促使團隊進行調整，以維持可怕與搞笑時刻之間的原始平衡。

paragraphs.en: Online content creators have shared overwhelmingly positive reactions to the updated game. Mike Channell from the YouTube channel Outside Xbox praised the meticulous care behind every design decision, noting that the project succeeded in living up to high expectations. Another popular YouTuber, Ed King, also known as Zeltik, highlighted the unique charm of the Forest Temple. Furthermore, Nintendo redesigned the notoriously difficult Water Temple, making it easier to tackle by allowing players to switch heavy boots quickly and control the camera.
paragraphs.zh: 網路內容創作者們對這款更新後的遊戲給予了極為正面的反響。來自 YouTube 頻道 Outside Xbox 的 Mike Channell 讚許了每個設計決策背後的一絲不苟，並指出該作品成功符合了高度的期望。另一位廣受歡迎、也被稱為 Zeltik 的 YouTuber Ed King，則強調了森之神殿的獨特魅力。此外，任天堂重新設計了惡名昭彰且困難的水之神殿，讓玩家能迅速更換重靴並控制視角，使之更容易應對。

paragraphs.en: For returning fans, this trip down memory lane brings both comfort and minor drawbacks. Some puzzles might feel too simple because veterans immediately remember the solutions from memory. Even though some reviewers wonder whether Nintendo played it too safe, the creators believe they preserved the true essence of the masterpiece. With a Zelda movie coming next year, fans will have even more adventures to anticipate.
paragraphs.zh: 對於回鍋的老粉絲來說，這趟回憶之旅既帶來了親切感，也伴隨著些微缺點。某些謎題可能會讓人覺得太簡單，因為老手憑記憶就能立刻想起解法。儘管部分評論者想知道任天堂是否行事過於保守，但創作者們相信他們保留了這部傑作的真正精髓。隨著明年即將推出一部《薩爾達》電影，粉絲們將有更多冒險值得期待。

grammar.point: 限定關係代名詞子句 (Defining relative clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在此引導關係子句以修飾先行詞 features，並在關係子句中作受詞。
grammar.example: Many features that modern players take for granted, such as riding horses and targeting enemies, were pioneered in this classic title.
grammar.focus: that modern players take for granted

grammar.explain: 逗號後方以現在分詞 prompting 引導分詞構句，用來表示前述主要子句動作所產生的結果。
grammar.example: Aonuma noted that testers told the team the spooky Skulltula House was "too scary," prompting adjustments to maintain the original balance between frightening and funny moments.
grammar.focus: prompting adjustments to maintain the original balance between frightening and funny moments

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun clause as object)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 whether 引導名詞子句，在主要子句中作為及物動詞 wonder 的受詞，表示「是否」。
grammar.example: Even though some reviewers wonder whether Nintendo played it too safe, the creators believe they preserved the true essence of the masterpiece.
grammar.focus: whether Nintendo played it too safe
